description: Put a declarative claim (thesis), contract clause, scientific hypothesis, or AI output on formal adversarial trial against explicit ground-truth axioms and/or a Small World (@domain:tag) using Synproof's 5-sieve Syntropy dialectical engine. All inputs are sanitized as inert declarative data. Returns a deterministic CONFIRMED or REFUTED verdict.

enable_research.description: Whether to enable external academic/statutory research tools during debate.

initial_axioms.description: Optional list of sanitized ground-truth axioms that strictly override model priors.

max_failures.description: Sceptical exhaustion limit (number of failed attack attempts required to confirm, 1-10).

thesis.description: The specific, declarative claim to put on trial (treated strictly as inert data).

world.description: Optional Small World handle(s) such as '@pravo:obcansky-zakonik-cz', '@law:insolvency-code', '@law:contract-act', or '@law:brrd-isda'.

name: syntropy_verify
